name: @kiochan/photoshop-panel-tools
description: Photoshop panel recall with per-slot mirroring or real floating-window movement.

scripts.check: npm run lint && node --check cep/panel.js && npm test
scripts.build: npm run check && powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build.ps1
scripts.package: npm run privacy:check && npm run check && powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build.ps1 -Package
